title: Transwell migration assay to interrogate human CAR-T cell chemotaxis
protocol: Determine the volume of whole blood to be processed.
Calculate the number of T cells to be transduced on day 2, add one for a non-transduced condition and multiply by 1.8.
Isolate PBMCs using density gradient centrifugation.
Dilute the whole blood by adding one part PBS.
Mix diluted whole blood gently with a serological pipette.
Dispense 15 mL of density gradient medium into sterile 50 mL conical tubes.
Carefully layer the diluted blood onto the density gradient medium, holding the tube at a 45° angle and leaning against the side with the pipette tip.
Centrifuge the samples at 1,000 × g for 20 min at 20°C in a swinging-bucket rotor.
Using a serological pipette carefully transfer each PBMC layer into new 50 mL conical tubes.
Fill the tubes with PBS before centrifuging at 520 × g for 15 min at 20°C.
Aspirate the supernatant and discard.
Resuspend the cell pellets in 5 ml of PBS each and pool PBMCs from the same donor into a single 50 mL conical tube.
Fill the tube with PBS and note the cell count of PBMCs using a hemocytometer or an automated cell counter.
Isolate pan T cells by magnetic enrichment.
Centrifuge the tube at 520 × g for 10 min at 20°C.
Aspirate the supernatant and discard.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 80 μL of cold MACS buffer per 10^7 cells.
Resuspend CD3 Microbeads thoroughly by vortexing for 15 seconds.
Add 20 μL of beads per 10^7 cells and mix the sample well by pipetting up and down.
Incubate for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Centrifuge the sample at 300 × g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Attach an LS Column onto a compatible MACS separator.
Put a 50 mL conical tube under the column to catch the flow through.
Apply 3 mL of cold MACS buffer onto the column.
Aspirate the supernatant and discard it.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 500 μL of cold MACS buffer.
Add another 50 μL of buffer for every additional 10^7 cells exceeding the first 10^8 cells.
Load the cell suspension onto the prepared LS Column.
Wash the column with 3 mL of cold MACS buffer and repeat this step two more times.
Discard the flow through.
Put a new 50 mL conical tube under the column.
Apply 5 mL of cold MACS buffer and immediately put on the plunger to recover the labeled pan T cells.
Add 25 mL of cold MACS buffer and perform a cell count.
Determine the amount of medium required to achieve a cell density of 10^6 cells/mL.
Prepare complete human T cell medium (c-hTcm) by supplementing hTcm with IL-2, IL-15, and 2-ME as specified.
Vigorously vortex CD3/CD28 T cell Activator Dynabeads for 30 seconds.
Transfer the volume required to achieve a bead-to-cell ratio of 1:3 into a tube.
Add an equal amount or 1 ml of PBS to the beads, whichever is higher, and wash by centrifugation at 400 x g for 1 minute.
Resuspend the beads in c-hTcm to match the initial volume transferred.
Centrifuge pan T cells at 400 × g for 10 minutes at 20°C.
Aspirate the supernatant and discard.
Resuspend the cell pellet in c-hTcm at a concentration of 10^6 cells/mL.
Seed pan T cells in a 6-well plate with a final volume of 3-4 mL/well.
Dispense prepared beads into individual wells at a final bead-to-cell ratio of 1:3, ensuring dispersion by pipetting up and down.
Incubate the cells for 48 hours at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Prepare a 6.25 μg/mL solution of Retronectin diluted in PBS.
Dispense 400 μL of diluted Retronectin into wells of a non-tissue treated 24-well plate.
Incubate the plate at 4°C for 16–20 h.
Aspirate and discard Retronectin solution from the 24-well plate prepared the day before.
Add 500 μL of blocking buffer (2% BSA in PBS) into each well.
Incubate on the bench for 30 min.
Thaw viral supernatant of constructs that will be used.
Remove the blocking buffer after 30 min incubation.
Wash the wells with 1 mL of PBS.
Deposit 1 mL of viral supernatant to wells intended for transduction.
Centrifuge the loaded plate at 3,000 × g for 1.5 h at 32°C.
Transduce and expand T cells.
Examine the isolated T cells under an inverted tissue-culture microscope.
Resuspend the stimulated T cells well by pipetting up and down.
Transfer them into a 50 mL conical tube and perform a cell count.
Centrifuge the cells at 400 × g for 5 min at 20°C.
Aspirate the supernatant and discard.
Resuspend the cell pellet in freshly supplemented c-hTcm at a concentration of 10^6 cells/mL.
Deposit 1 mL of T cells suspended in fresh c-hTcm into virus-coated Retronectin plate wells.
Return to a 37°C incubator.
Every other day perform a cell count and subculture cells in fresh c-hTcm.
Check transduction efficiency as early as 72 h after transduction using a flow cytometer.
Prepare required assay media, including positive and baseline controls for the transwell migration assay.
Dilute recombinant human CXCL16 in migration medium to a final concentration of 50 ng/mL.
Prepare migration medium with 10% human serum as a positive control.
Use migration medium alone to establish a baseline.
Harvest T cells and transfer them into 50 mL conical tubes, pooling cells from the same conditions.
Perform a cell count of each condition.
Centrifuge the cells at 400 × g for 5 min at 20°C.
Aspirate the supernatant and discard.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 30 mL of PBS and centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at 20°C.
Aspirate the supernatant and discard.
Repeat this step one more time.
Resuspend the cells in migration medium at a concentration of 1 × 10^6 cells/70 μL (∼14.29 × 10^6 cells/mL).
Take a transwell migration plate into a laminar flow hood.
Deposit 70 μL of cell suspension into the upper chamber (also called the insert) of the transwell plate.
Add 225 μL of assay medium into the lower chamber without removing the insert.
Employ a reverse pipetting technique to prevent bubble formation.
Push the knob all the way down to the second stop, aspirate the sample and dispose by pushing the knob until the first stop.
Repeat as often as needed.
Put the lid on gently without applying any pressure and transfer the plate to an incubator.
Let the cells migrate for 4 h.
Take out the transwell plate carefully and remove the lid.
Use cotton swabs to get rid of any remaining liquid in the upper chamber to minimize the risk of spillover.
Disassemble the transwell plate carefully by holding the plate firmly in place with one hand, while removing the insert with the other.
Lift the cells by pipetting up and down and transfer the cells into a round bottom 96-well plate.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at 20°C.
Discard supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 200 μL of FACS buffer.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at 20°C.
Repeat once more.
Prepare a master mix of fluorescently labeled antibodies in FACS buffer.
Discard supernatant and resuspend the cells in the prepared master mix.
Incubate at 4°C for 20 min.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min.
Discard supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 200 μL of FACS buffer.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at 20°C.
Repeat once more.
Discard supernatant and resuspend the cells in 100 μL of FACS buffer.
Samples are ready for acquisition.
Optional: Add counting beads to the cell suspension prior to acquisition.
Ensure accurate cell counts by following specific product instructions.
Establish baseline for the impedance-based real-time cell analysis tool.
Seed target SUIT-2-MSLN-CXCL16 cells into the assay wells.
Maintain target cells in tumor cell line medium before use.
Prewarm cytotoxicity medium and 1× trypsin-EDTA to 37°C.
Deposit 50 μl of cytotoxicity medium or PBS into all wells of an E-Plate 96.
Perform background measurement on the E-Plate 96 using a control unit (a laptop).
Remove the medium from target cells, wash them with PBS, and treat them with 1× trypsin-EDTA.
Incubate at 37°C, checking on the cells every minute.
Add serum-containing medium as soon as 90% of the cells have detached.
Transfer the cells into a 50 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at 20°C.
Aspirate and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in cytotoxicity medium.
Add 100 μL of cell suspension into each well of the E-Plate 96 using a multichannel pipette.
Resuspend regularly to prevent uneven cell seeding.
Let the target cells settle for 45–60 min on the bench.
Return the E-Plate 96 to the RTCA cradle.
Initiate step 2 of the RTCA experiment using the control unit.
Incubate until an appropriate Cell Index is reached (e.g., 1–2).
Run a transwell migration assay.
Seed 2.5 × 10^4 SUIT-2-MSLN-CXCL16 cells/well in a final volume of 225 μL of cytotoxicity medium in a TC-treated transwell receiver plate.
Incubate for 24 h at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Harvest T cells and transfer them into 50 mL conical tubes, pooling cells from the same conditions.
Perform a cell count of each condition.
Centrifuge the cells at 400 × g for 5 min at 20°C.
Aspirate the supernatant and discard.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 30 mL of PBS and centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at 20°C.
Aspirate the supernatant and discard.
Resuspend the cells in cytotoxicity medium at a concentration of 5 × 10^5 cells/70 μL (∼7.14 × 10^6 cells/mL).
Take the TC-treated receiver plate with chemoattractant-secreting cells and a transwell migration plate into a laminar flow hood.
Remove the lids of both plates.
Carefully move the transwell insert and place it onto the TC-treated receiver plate.
Deposit 70 μL of cell suspension into the upper chamber.
Put the lid on gently without applying any pressure and transfer the plate to an incubator.
Let the cells migrate for 4 h.
Seed effector cells.
Confirm that the Cell Index is in the desired range.
Take out the transwell plate carefully and remove the lid.
Use cotton swabs to get rid of any remaining liquid in the upper chamber to minimize the risk of spillover.
Take care not to damage the membrane.
Disassemble the transwell plate carefully by holding the plate firmly with one hand while removing the insert with the other.
Abort the current step running (step 2) and start the next one using the control unit.
Pause the experiment immediately after the first sweep.
Carefully release and remove the E-Plate 96 from the cradle.
Bring the E-Plate 96 into the laminar flow hood and remove its lid.
Resuspend the cells in the lower chamber of the transwell plate by pipetting up and down.
Transfer 100 μL of the migrated cells into the wells of the E-Plate 96.
Put the lid back on and return the E-Plate 96 into the cradle.
Press continue on the control unit to resume the experiment.
Lift the remaining cells in the lower chamber by pipetting up and down.
Transfer 100 μL of the cell suspension into a round bottom 96-well plate.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 minutes at 20°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 200 μL of FACS buffer.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 minutes at 20°C.
Repeat the centrifugation and resuspension steps once more.
Prepare a master mix of fluorescently labeled antibodies in FACS buffer to stain receptors of interest.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cells in the prepared master mix.
Incubate at 4°C for 20 minutes.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 minutes.
Discard supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 200 μL of FACS buffer.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at 20°C.
Repeat once more.
Discard supernatant and resuspend the cells in 100 μL of FACS buffer.
Samples are ready for acquisition.
